name: CFL Center Performance
query:
SELECT 
    cs.cfl_center as center_name,
    cs.district,
    cs.region,
    COUNT(cs.name) as total_sessions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cs.village) as villages_covered,
    SUM(cs.participant_count) as total_participants,
    AVG(cs.participant_count) as avg_participants_per_session,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cs.docstatus = 1 THEN 1 END) as submitted_sessions,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cs._state = 'Approved' THEN 1 END) as approved_sessions,
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN cs._state = 'Approved' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(cs.name)) as approval_rate,
    MAX(cs.date) as last_session_date
FROM 
    `tabCFL Session` cs
WHERE 
    (%(region)s IS NULL OR cs.region = %(region)s)
    AND (%(month_year)s IS NULL OR DATE_FORMAT(cs.date, '%Y-%m') = %(month_year)s)
GROUP BY 
    cs.cfl_center, cs.district, cs.region
ORDER BY 
    total_sessions DESC
